_comment: Edit this, not the code. Models are Claude Code aliases (opus/sonnet/haiku) or full model ids.
goal: Phase 3 — work items, feeds and travel time (BRIEF-PRODUCT.md "Phase 3"). The Phase 3 design pass has landed in design/ (commit 1c58185) but STATUS.md still describes Phase 1 and DEVIATIONS.md is a Phase 1 punch list, so neither reflects what is actually built — reconcile them against the code before planning new work. Then build Phase 3 in the brief's order: manual work items (assignment/project/exam with effort + confidence) first, then time logging with estimated-vs-actual, then ICS subscription import, then TravelTimeProvider with MKDirections and the leave-by band. Moodle REST and CalDAV last. Done means the real timetable appears, on-campus lectures show a leave-by time, and time can be logged against coursework.
